method: Visual reading of bounded source pages and publishing specimens. Native PDF objects are hashed after pdfimages -all; Kim figure objects are lossless PNG extractions. Catalog labels and scholarly transcriptions remain separately graded.

sanche_printed_2017_specimens.dating_limit: The seller reports a Zhengde 13 (1518) bear-family Thick Virtue Hall source imprint. This does not date the particular Korean Eulhaeja impression. The public catalog labels 1518 and Jungjong 15 together; originals required.

nlk_ziweishu.text_scope: Central circle and selected clearly visible star names only; procedural context and complete twelve sectors not transcribed.
nlk_ziweishu.reader_access: Catalog says free off-site; browser HTML launches a locally installed viewer. No full-volume pages obtained this session.
nlk_ziweishu.comparison: The stem-branch 己巳 is wood in the received nayin tables. A later online Zhongtian transcription assigns 木局三數 and days 6–8 to 卯. This matches the single observed setting; source identity, algorithm order and priority chronologies remain unbound.

xuansou_catalog_and_secondary_image.sample_limits: 300×640, 十干變曜 heading and several star labels visible. Attribution and p62–63 locator are supplied by the post, not authenticated by an official image match.

historical_limits: No undated surviving copy is assigned the year of its archival reference, script type, composition, reported preface or digital exhibit.
Overlap in year/day terms, chapters or one chart example does not establish exclusive descent or identical historical operation.
The Baizhong Jing source of Nancun Chuogeng Lu and the Zhaodan title relationship remain open.
